recommended_candidate: Current-pattern classifier with verified field labels; hybrid hydraulic integrity classifier.

source_model.type: BP neural network 45 inputs–15 hidden–10 outputs plus analytical pressure-buildup model.
source_model.inputs: Field and synthetic current cards; abstract training across>900 wells; at least 50 simulated examples per class; 45 features from 24 h cards; hydraulic model needs fluid/completion/pump curve.
source_model.outputs: Ten current-card classes plus hydraulic diagnosis.
source_model.accuracy: No held-out aggregate accuracy. Case output 57% normal, 12.3% sand failed to identify leak; pressure method led to confirmed tubing leak.
source_model.advantages: Directly addresses absence of downhole sensors using additional surface test evidence.
source_model.limitations: Synthetic training and validation not fully characterized; current classes overlap; Figure 5 rendering partly corrupted; empirical 0.78/1.5/1 cutoffs not universal.
source_model.availability: Current features possible from Avalon; full pressure method needs dedicated time-resolved test and extra completion/PVT/curve data. Routine Excel pressures/tests alone insufficient.

recommended_candidate: Vibration residual benchmark only on wells retaining reliable vibration.

source_model.type: Per-ESP PCA T² versus XGBoost motor-vibration regression residual with SPC aggregation.
source_model.inputs: Six failed ESPs>1 year history; initial windows grown 20,000 min to 210,000 min; preferred 180,000 min~125 days; sequential 80/20 within-window validation for regression.
source_model.outputs: Abnormal minute/day and persistent failure advisory.
source_model.accuracy: Table 1 PCA false alarms 1, 4, 0, 3, 5; leads 14, 7, 1, 1, 3 days (first 5). Nonlinear false alarms 1, 11, 12, 10, 6; leads 14, 41, 10,120, 13. Sixth poor-quality well: PCA19 false/2 days, nonlinear 2 false/327 days, excluded from averages. No classification accuracy or independent nonfailure cohort.
source_model.advantages: Chronological per-well construction and explicit alarm persistence tradeoff.
source_model.limitations: Six failed wells only; parameter selection retrospective; no fleet rate denominator; two-day persistence delays fast faults; real-power proxy I×V omits three-phase power factor/efficiency.
source_model.availability: PCA needs pressure/rate/temperature; residual method requires measured vibration at scoring, not just surface predictors. Cannot calculate residual after losing vibration sensor.

recommended_candidate: Knowledge-assisted surface classifier after reliable rate/label integration.

source_model.type: Meta-learning convolutional shrinkage symptom model; semantic/fault trees; Jaccard entity linking; graph subgraph ranking; BiLSTM-CRF and expert inference, choosing higher-confidence result.
source_model.inputs: 1373 offshore fault records over 10 years; 7398 sentences from 62 papers+10 annual reports; 14 series; 27 symptoms; 50 claimed fault classes; 70/15/15 record split 961/206/206; separate 80/20 meta-stage description.
source_model.outputs: Ranked fault candidates and confidence.
source_model.accuracy: Recall@3=93.35%, reported macro F1=89.93%, time 35.5 (unit not explicit in table). LSTM73.26/83.26/33.2; KG-BDA88.10/87.74/37.9. Not 93.35% top-one accuracy. Warning/alarm table 38.3/32.6 versus 42.9/32.8 without sufficiently clear timing definition.
source_model.advantages: Surface-based inputs; explicit symptoms, candidates and explanation; knowledge helps sparse classes.
source_model.limitations: Restricted private data/graph; hard exclusions physically overbroad; random event split not external-field validation; equation 8 accuracy omits TN and F1 derivation inconsistent; confidence scores from two models may be incomparable; exact 50-label taxonomy not cleanly enumerated.
source_model.availability: Potentially close to project, but requires continuous surface channels, plant rate-estimation method, verified fault labels and graph. Sparse Excel tests cannot substitute for minute production estimates. No downhole sensors required by core input set.

recommended_candidate: Censored survival/competing-risk model with past-only operating exposure.

source_model.type: Linear regression, decision tree and logistic regression at multiple time scales.
source_model.inputs: Geology/trajectory plus whole-run or current-period summaries; 42 paired failure/non failure periods; all-period set 29 fail/891 nonfail.
source_model.outputs: Total life, active hours-to-failure and period failure probability.
source_model.accuracy: Geology+geometry R².41(adj.38); hours-on regression R².75(adj.73), tree.82. Paired classifier TP30, FN12, FP18, TN24=>recall 71.43%, precision 62.5%. All-period fitted TP25, FN4, FP1, TN890=>recall 86.21%, precision 96.15%, but evaluated on fitting data; authors acknowledge optimism and unsuccessful small-data validation.
source_model.advantages: Distinguishes calendar time, active exposure and failure versus other stops.
source_model.limitations: Completed-run summaries leak future information if used as prospective predictors; only 29/42 failure cases; correlated features; no reliable external validation or forecast lead.
source_model.availability: Surface concepts transferable, but SAGD steam/injector/geological inputs absent from stated sources. Ordinary water injection cannot substitute for SAGD steam variables.

recommended_candidate: CatBoost/ExtraTrees benchmark with independently labeled future events, including raw-feature ablation.

source_model.type: Isolation Forest→PCA5 PCs→CatBoost/ExtraTrees with temporal features; SVM/MLP comparators; SMOTE/class weights reported.
source_model.inputs: One selected well of 7,105 day window, 87390 raw records; 83020 final prose versus 82350 table; 30 s claimed sampling.
source_model.outputs: Rule-derived three-state class.
source_model.accuracy: Abstract accuracy 94.2%, failure recall 96.5%; Table 9 CatBoost 99.85% accuracy/F1~99.83%; Table 10/11 CV97.2% accuracy, F1~97.2%; ExtraTrees 96.8% test/93.8% CV. These are distinct conflicting reports, not one validated score.
source_model.advantages: Useful past-window trend features and comparison of practical tabular models.
source_model.limitations: One well, selected anomalous window; labels depend on same signals as features; no independent event-level prospective validation; chronological versus stratified K-fold descriptions conflict; preprocessing/SMOTE placement unclear; outlier removal may discard true faults; claimed 5 PC variance 90/95/97% inconsistent.
source_model.availability: Requires working downhole pressure/temperature/vibration; surface voltage/current prior to transformer must not be treated as motor-terminal values. Missing-sensor version untested.

recommended_candidate: Normal-behavior multivariate anomaly model per sensor/equipment cohort.

source_model.type: Generic multilayer neural-network anomaly detector; architecture/loss not disclosed.
source_model.inputs: 30 onshore ESPs, 200–500 k W; equipment variants grouped; one-year normal training baseline; surface/downhole telemetry.
source_model.outputs: Anomaly level and prioritized advisory.
source_model.accuracy: 12 day retrospective example; no precision, recall, confusion matrix, false alerts per well-month or independent event denominator.
source_model.advantages: Learns complex normal relationships; can highlight previously unrecognized anomalies.
source_model.limitations: Manual training-data curation; repeated tuning on same history; missing cause specificity; limited reproducibility; related publications reuse pilot evidence.
source_model.availability: Potential Avalon-fed monitoring, but full published model uses downhole inputs. A sensor-lost cohort requires new baseline and validation; Excel tests supply contextual evidence rather than fast stream.
